entries.title: Hebrews 12:1
segments: Compassed about. Referring to the illustrious heroes of faith spoken of in the preceding chapter.  They had borne witness to the truth in their earthly life; they had now become heavenly witnesses, or spectators, or the struggles of those who were contending for the eternal reward.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:2
segments: Looking unto Jesus. Faithfully modeling character after the perfect example of Jesus.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:4
segments: Resisted into blood. They had not yet faced death for the sake of holiness.  Nor do men to-day face death, as Christ did, for the sake of truth.  Conditions have changed.  The usual results of truth-speaking and of action in conformity to unwelcome truth are now ridicule, unpopularity, loss of reputation, business, wealth, social standing.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:7
segments: Chastening. The discipline of suffering, patiently endured and hence leading to richer and nobler character.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:9
segments:
Father of Spirits. God, the Father of our spirits.
 

 
 And live.  Obedience to God is life.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:12
segments: Lift up. Comfort and cheer the downcast and sorrowing.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:13
segments: Make straight paths. Smooth, level paths, free from obstructions that may cause to stumble those who are weaker than ourselves.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:16
segments: Profane person, as Esau. Esau had no proper appreciation of his birthright, inasmuch as he had not thought of the spiritual blessing that accompanied it.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:18
segments: Mount that might be touched. Mount Sinai.  See

. The mount that might be touched was Mount Sinai on earth.  Here God was distant, fearful, the God of the thunder and the black clouds.  We are come up to a mountain invisible yet real, where heaven meets earth and God communes with his people.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:20
segments: If even a best touch the mountain, etc. A fact which illustrated the rigor necessary in compelling reverence for sacred things, and affording a contrast between the Mosaic law and the grace and freedom which came through Christ.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:21
segments: So fearful. 'Fearful' is an accurate description of the Hebrew mind in its attitude toward God as revealed in the early history of Israel.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:22
segments: Mount Zion. The great contrast to Mount Sinai.  Mount Zion is the mount of the New Testament age, and an emblem of all its spiritual blessings.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:23
segments: General assembly and church, etc.  The gathering of all God's children, including those in the visible church on earth and the church invisible in heaven.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:24
segments: Better than that of Abel. The blood of Abel spoke from the ground with a cry for vengeance; Christ's blood speaks of love, mercy, and pardon.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:27
segments: Yet once more, etc.  The temporal things shall pass away.  The eternal shall remain.

entries.title: Hebrews 12:28
segments: Let us have grace. Feel and express thankfulness.
